# TypeScript Gateway (tsgate)

> A simple gateway, it's all you need. Production-grade TypeScript HTTP API gateway with zero runtime dependencies.

## Overview
TypeScript Gateway is a high-performance, lightweight API gateway built natively in TypeScript. Designed for high throughput, low latency, and zero runtime dependencies outside Node.js built-ins.

## Core Features
- Zero runtime dependencies
- High-performance routing with wildcard and regex parameters
- Comprehensive middleware pipeline (auth, rate limiting, load shedding, caching, transformation, SSRF guard, HMAC verification)
- Resilient load balancing and circuit breaking
- Real-time observability, metrics aggregation, and Prometheus formatting
- Dynamic plugin execution system

## Architecture
- Functional core, imperative shell design
- Pluggable policy execution pipeline
- Zero-allocation fast paths for core routing and load balancing

## API Endpoints & Gateway Capabilities
- HTTP proxy forwarding with upstream streaming
- Rate limiting (token bucket / fixed window)
- HMAC signature verification and validation
- SSRF guard and security header injection
- Upstream authentication and credential store
- WebSocket tunneling and bidirectional proxying
